name: The Fathom House
description:
There is a house at the bottom of the sea that welcomes all travelers. It has been there for thousands of years. Its origins are obscure. Its architecture is an amalgamation of countless additions, expansions, collapses, repairs and renovations throughout the ages. It is oft said that all sea-roads lead to it and indeed, though it lies in a region of perpetual calm, swirling currents all around it pull down both the wayward and the willing.

Within its walls and under its five-score gables are dozens - perhaps hundreds - of rooms for lodging and meeting. Some say there are doors in far hallways that lead elsewhere, too. But greatest of all - and first to meet the arriving traveler - is the Great Common Room, where ancient, barnacled chairs surround deeply worn tables and the Keeper serves sea-ale in mugs wrought of coral, salvaged from sunken wrecks, or gifted to the House by loving patrons past and present. Ever there is lively conversation, news, rumor and song, and above all: the beginnings of quests...

⁂ ⁂ ⁂

If you choose to use this world module, place The Fathom House on your campaign's World Map, and on an Intermezzo of days or longer, any player character may choose to lodge in The Fathom House - provided they can reasonably travel to and from it. If they do, they choose a number of Cultures equal to the number of ranks they have in Courtesy. They hear news and rumors from each of the chosen Cultures. The news and rumors are determined by the other players, together or taking turns.

Describe the atmosphere in the Fathom House and who you converse with.
